title: Create Based Pack 2
description: Create Based Pack 2 is an industrial sandbox merging the mechanical magic of Create with advanced nuclear tech and digital storage.
body:
⚙️ **Create Based Pack 2** ⚙️

**Welcome to Create Based Pack 2!** This pack is built for those who find beauty in the rotation of a shaft, the hum of a fusion reactor.

It combines the mechanical creativity of Create with the high-tech power of Mekanism, Applied Energistics 2, and Ender IO.



🚀 **Key Features**

- 🔩 The Create Ecosystem
Featuring Aeronautics, Big Cannons, New Age, and Enchantment Industry for a truly limitless building experience.
- 🏭 Advanced Tech
Dive into Mekanism, Industrial Foregoing, and PneumaticCraft for heavy-industry processing and automation.
- ⚛️ Power & Atoms
High-stakes energy management with Electrodynamics, Nuclear Science, and Nuclearism.
- 📦 Storage Solved
Massive digital storage via Applied Energistics 2 and Integrated Dynamics.
- 🎮 Smooth Gameplay
Powered by Sodium, Iris, and FerriteCore to keep performance high even when your factory becomes enormous.

 
To recap, this modpack includes many mods that expand the well-known Create ecosystem with countless add-ons, such as Create Deco for decorations, Create Drill Drain for quarry creation, and Create: Interiors for decorating the interiors of your vehicles, along with many more add-ons.

I also added Applied Energistics 2, allowing you to create advanced storage networks, instantly access your items, and automate crafting without limits.

The pack also includes Carry On, because transporting your chests on a flying ship should absolutely be possible, along with unique dungeons to explore.




🖥️ System Requirements
💡 Recommended Allocation: 8+ GB of RAM is highly recommended to ensure smooth gameplay and stable performance as your factories scale.
